item.title: Morning Weather for Saturday, September 05
item.description: Good morning! Happy weekend! A whole day to play. Let's find out what the weather is like on this Saturday, September 5. Saturday! No school and no hurry today. Today in Shanghai, it will be a little bit rainy. The high will be 30 degrees, and the low will be 25 degrees. Rain is about 41 percent likely today. It's going to be hot. Drink lots of water and wear a hat! If it rains later, look up afterwards. Sometimes a rainbow comes out to say hello. And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be drizzly, with a high of 29 degrees. A question for you: what song would you like to hear today? That's your weather. Have a wonderful day!
